title: Published O2 D4 flux-threshold quick scan
question: Do finite-size curves for the published intrinsically heralded O2 MWPM decoder change size direction near the paper value p_c=0.20842?
scope: Paper-normalized periodic D4 honeycomb, X-only non-Abelian charge-pair noise, perfect first fusion record, published O2 weights w_e=1-n_e(27L^2), first-stage Boolean-union flux logical failure.

decoder.visible_record: flux syndrome plus sampled intermediate Abelian charge outcomes
decoder.score: Boolean-union flux winding; terminal physical windings are reported separately and counted as failures only in the unconditional sensitivity

acceptance: Complete all 16 cells with 1000 attempted histories per cell and deterministic replay seeds.
Report conditional and terminal-restored flux risks with 90% Wilson intervals.
Report adjacent-size risk differences with 90% independent bootstrap intervals.
Estimate a quick finite-size crossing only when adjacent-size differences change sign inside the registered grid; otherwise report a bracket or no resolved crossing.
Plot all finite-size O2 curves and mark the paper reference p_c=0.20842 without treating it as fitted project data.
claim_boundary: This is a quick 1000-shot-per-cell finite-size reproduction check. It can show consistency or tension with a threshold near 0.20842, but cannot reproduce the paper's quoted 2e-5 uncertainty, its L=10--28 scale, or its approximately one-million-sample-per-point analysis.

execution.conclusion: Quick finite-size evidence is compatible with the paper threshold neighborhood, but the paper value p_c=0.20842(2) is not reproduced at this sample and size scale.
